messages:
Maya: Heads up — APAC marketplace listing needs legal sign-off before we can flip the publish toggle. Deadline by EOD Wed APAC. @Ana can you confirm? :clock3:
Ana: On it. Legal asked for updated data residency blurb and proof of SOC2. Pinging security.
Liam: We have SOC2 evidence from the Dedicated cluster — I'll attach link in the doc. Also SI onboarding for CloudScale is delayed by their cert window.
Maya: Who owns localization for JA/ZH? We need translations for the landing hero and the TOU excerpt.
Priya: I can own JA with help from ops. ETA Tue noon PST.
Sam: We need a plan B if SI doesn't finish — suggest we soft-launch APAC with partner "CloudScale (no-SI)" flag and an inline note that SI integration is coming. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Ana: Legal ok with soft-launch note as long as we don't promise SI timelines. I'll draft copy.
deploy-bot: staging deploy successful for marketplace-landing v1.4.2 — preview at https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/preview/3172024
Maya: Great. Can folks review preview by COB today? Quick checklist: 1) legal blurb, 2) hero localization, 3) SI integration section, 4) press embargo time.
Liam: I reviewed hero copy for EN/FR. Uploaded suggestions to doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx
Priya: Started JA translation, 40% done. Need final hero art size from design.
Eli: Sending assets to Priya now. Also confirming responsive cut for mobile.
Sam: Press embargo — proposed 2026-06-15 15:00 UTC. This leaves us room for legal + SI contingency.
Maya: That date works for sales. @Liam please confirm partner comms timeline for CloudScale.
Liam: I'll sync with their PM today, expect response by EOD. If delayed, we'll push embargo 48h.
Maya: Action items — Ana (legal) draft soft-launch note, Priya (loc) complete JA by Tue noon PST, Liam (partner) confirm SI timeline, Eli (design) finalize assets, Sam (press) prep embargo email. Check back 3pm PST. :white_check_mark:
